Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About The Role
 In this role, you will work as a Senior Full-Stack Java Engineer on large-scale corporate systems supporting calls, proposals, grants, audits, and funding management within a European public-sector environment.
You will develop and maintain secure, scalable applications across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, cloud, and CI/CD while also contributing to code reviews, mentoring, requirements refinement, and production support.
 Responsibilities
Develop and maintain front-end and back-end application components
Implement business logic, responsive UI, APIs, and database interactions
Design and secure RESTful APIs and web services
Apply security best practices for authentication, authorization, storage, logging, and monitoring
Perform unit and integration testing, debugging, and production troubleshooting
Deploy applications using cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes
Monitor lower environments, performance, and application stability
Perform code reviews and support technical onboarding and mentoring
Collaborate with QA teams and participate in requirements refinement and estimation
Maintain technical documentation and code quality standards
 Requirements
University degree corresponding to EQF Level 6, typically a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
7+ years of professional IT experience
Strong Java backend expertise with Spring Boot, Hibernate, and REST API development
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MongoDB, including schema design and query optimization
Experience with WebLogic, JEE, and EJB
Experience with AWS or Azure and cloud application deployment
Experience designing and securing REST APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger
Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT
Knowledge of Angular, React, Vue, or Bootstrap
Experience with Maven, GitLab, Bamboo, Jenkins, Nexus, or similar CI/CD and build tools
Experience with Jira, Git, Bitbucket, and wiki-based collaboration tools
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of SOA and service bus architectures
Experience with Agile and Scrum
Experience with JUnit and Mockito
Experience with SonarQube, SonarLint, HP Fortify, or similar code analysis tools
Experience with Apache Camel
Experience with Drools or similar rule engines
Experience with AI coding tools such as Amazon Q or Kiro
Knowledge of system analysis and project management will be a plus
Strong mentoring, communication, and technical leadership skills
English or French proficiency at B2 level or higher
